item.description: - The Mac commit sheet commits only the files you reviewed and selected, and leaves other staged changes alone. Resolved merges can be committed from it, and a commit that finished before a timeout is no longer reported as failed. - Branch changes apply to the checkout of the thread you are viewing. On iPhone and iPad, Send and Queue wait until the Mac confirms the branch change, and a refusal from the Mac is shown in the composer. - Pull request handoffs and thread links now match the right repository when two repositories use the same pull request number. - A question stays filled in if the response is refused, so you can retry it without retyping, on Mac, iPhone and iPad. On Android, answered questions keep their selection when a chat reloads, and options use native radio buttons and checkboxes. - Apple Watch uses secure entry for private answers and sends requests that need an external page to iPhone. Signing out on iPhone clears chat details, drafts and pending replies from the watch. - Collapsing a transcript section while it is still loading now stays collapsed. Leaving a chat on iPhone or iPad cancels a dictation that was still starting, and file listings there reload with your current hidden-file setting. The project and Mac menus in the new chat header open from the name you tap, including in languages with a different word order.

- SwiftDroid's ChatGPT, Gemini, Anthropic and Claude Code connections now share one entry. Manage them from a single panel in Mac Settings, and browse their models together in the picker on Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android. Existing chats, favorites and permissions keep their provider. - SwiftDroid now uses version 0.5.2 of its SDK. Gemini requests send the reasoning levels the connected model supports, and Script reads get a larger payload budget. - In Mac Settings, right-click a harness in the sidebar to remove a provider account. The confirmation names the account you clicked. - Agents in Controller can use Apple's 19 Xcode skills, including translation with localization style guides and xctrace profiling. - On a Mac with a touch screen, drag one finger to scroll a browser page or local terminal. Tapping away closes the New Thread palette and folder browser, and in the folder browser a second tap opens the selected folder. Scrolling or long-pressing no longer dismisses an open model, context or plan card.

# Controller 1.0.51 (101)
Offline prompt delivery and more Siri actions for Mac, iPhone and iPad, plus matching builds for Apple Watch and Android.
- Controller Connect can hold a text prompt for an existing chat when its Mac is offline, for up to seven days, and deliver it when that Mac reconnects. Siri tells you the prompt is pending, and the composer on Mac, iPhone and iPad lists it under **Waiting for this Mac**. Both the sending device and the Mac need this version, and the option appears once the Controller Connect service update reaches your account. Attachments, slash commands and new chats still need a live connection. - On iPhone and iPad with the iOS 27.3 Siri AI Developer Preview, Siri can find your computers and projects and start a new thread in a project, list only the chats waiting for your input or approval, and read further back through a chat.
